body.name: Rational near-minimax certificate
body.construction: A tuple \((\widehat q,\widehat t,\widehat X,\widehat s)\in\mathbb Q^L\times\mathbb Q\times\mathbb Q^{2n\times2n}\times\mathbb Q\) satisfying \(\widehat q\ge0\), \(\mathbf 1_L^{\mathsf T}\widehat q=1\), \(\widehat tH^{-1}-Q(\widehat q)\succeq0\), \(\widehat X\succeq0\), \(\operatorname{tr}(H^{-1}\widehat X)=1\), \(\operatorname{tr}(Q_{\ell}\widehat X)\ge\widehat s\) for every \(\ell\), and \(B^2(\widehat t-\widehat s)\le\varepsilon\).
